name: Lagoon City — structural sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Dense ivory/pearl canal settlement with teal domes, stacked roof terraces, arched pedestrian bridges, balconies and water-level entries. Palms and orange-fruited courtyard trees are visibly distinct from woodland planting; mini-plan has multiple water courts/canals. Hidden layout inference: Build one legible arrival quay and a main canal loop connecting three or four courtyard clusters. Footpaths cross on arch bridges while boats remain in lower channels; roof walks return to public stairs rather than dead-end private-looking windows. Vary low water homes, corner houses and taller terrace landmarks. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "B09-STRUCT-001 — Lagoon City — structural sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need canal-house frontage/corner/roof host families, quay-water transition, terrace stair and bridge landing; existing ivory lattice/teal roof/water motifs reused. Citrus/palm/bank flora need their own habitat audit. Small fish/waterbirds proposed; no complete city or interiors claimed. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
